title: One-way collision doesn't work for already colliding bodies
body:
### Tested versions

Tested in 4.4.1.stable (https://github.com/godotengine/godot/commit/49a5bc7b616bd04689a2c89e89bda41f50241464)

### System information

Godot v4.4.1.stable - Windows 10 (build 19045) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated AMD Radeon RX 6700 XT (Advanced Micro Devices, Inc.; 32.0.12033.1030) - 12th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-12400F (12 threads)

### Issue description

When two bodies are already colliding and the one-way direction changes to the opposite direction, then it won't get detected by the body that is trying to pass through, so it will remain blocked.

How it works now:
<video controls src="https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/b8370f90-f4c1-4c3e-8c79-6bdf5df33eb8" title="Title"></video>
How it should work:
<video controls src="https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/acda46c8-45b5-4014-a49e-35275cfb7ac8" title="Title"></video>

### Steps to reproduce

- Move a dynamic rigid body (by force or by setting state velocity) into the colliding side of a physics body that 
  has a shape with one-way collision enabled
- Change the one way direction to face the opposite direction (by flipping the body for example), so that the body should be able to pass through

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[onewaycollisiontest.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/20047780/onewaycollisiontest.zip)
